review_candidates.title: ANALISTA DE SUPORTE AO USUÁRIO - RS
review_candidates.location: Passo Fundo, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil
review_candidates.description: Efetivo (CLT) Empresa de tecnologia, integrante de um grupo internacional, busca profissional para atuar no suporte técnico aos usuários, com foco no atendimento, na resolução de incidentes e na orientação para o uso adequado de sistemas e ferramentas corporativas. O profissional irá atuar na análise e resolução de incidentes técnicos de maior complexidade (N2 e N3) nos sistemas ERP e nas soluções de documentos fiscais eletrônicos da empresa, investigando causas, validando comportamentos do sistema e articulando soluções com as equipes técnicas. Principais responsabilidades:Assumir chamados escalados pelo suporte inicial, conduzindo atendimentos N2 e N3 que exijam investigação aprofundada de falhas em sistemas ERP, aplicações fiscais e integrações entre soluções. Investigar incidentes relacionados ao processamento, emissão, consulta e transmissão de documentos fiscais eletrônicos, identificando possíveis causas em parametrizações, regras de negócio, cadastros, comunicação entre sistemas ou serviços integrados. Reproduzir cenários reportados pelos clientes, analisar evidências, logs e mensagens de erro disponíveis e executar testes técnicos para diferenciar falhas de uso, configuração, integração, ambiente ou comportamento do software. Diagnosticar e solucionar ocorrências complexas em módulos e rotinas de ERP, considerando os impactos em processos como faturamento, cadastros, movimentações e rotinas administrativas, conforme o escopo dos produtos atendidos. Analisar falhas em integrações, troca de arquivos, comunicação entre aplicações e fluxos de dados, reunindo evidências técnicas e funcionais para direcionar a investigação e a correção. Atuar em conjunto com desenvolvimento, produto, implantação e demais áreas técnicas na análise de defeitos, inconsistências e incidentes que demandem correção, informando com clareza os testes realizados, o impacto e o comportamento esperado. Avaliar a abrangência e a criticidade dos incidentes, priorizando atendimentos conforme impacto nos processos dos clientes e risco de interrupção operacional, e acompanhar os casos até a validação da solução. Documentar diagnósticos, evidências, causa identificada, contorno aplicado e solução definitiva, transformando casos recorrentes em artigos técnicos e orientações que aumentem a autonomia do suporte e reduzam reincidências. Requisitos obrigatórios:Experiência sólida em suporte técnico a sistemas empresariais, preferencialmente em atendimento de níveis 2 e 3. Experiência com sistemas ERP e/ou soluções de emissão, processamento ou gestão de documentos fiscais eletrônicos. Facilidade para investigar problemas e orientar usuários de diferentes níveis de conhecimento. Ensino superior em andamento ou concluído em Tecnologia da Informação, Administração ou áreas afins. Experiências e conhecimentos desejáveis:Experiência com atendimento técnico em ambientes corporativos. Familiaridade com registro e gestão de chamados. Conhecimento de sistemas operacionais, aplicações empresariais e ferramentas de suporte. Experiência com atendimento remoto e acompanhamento de incidentes. Experiência em suporte técnico N2 e N3, com investigação de incidentes complexos e interação com equipes de desenvolvimento. Conhecimento de processos fiscais e contábeis, documentos fiscais eletrônicos e rotinas de sistemas ERP. Salário:A negociar. The role involves developing data ingestion, transformation, and processing workflows that handle large volumes of structured and unstructured data. The engineer will work extensively with Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Event Hubs, Apache Spark, and PySpark to build modern data platforms and streaming solutions. In addition to data engineering responsibilities, the engineer will contribute to backend development, API integrations, software architecture, and distributed systems. The role requires close collaboration with software engineers, data architects, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions. The engineer will also be responsible for optimizing data processing performance, ensuring data quality and reliability, implementing monitoring and error-handling mechanisms, and following best practices for security, scalability, and maintainability. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable real-time and batch data pipelines on Microsoft Azure. Build and maintain streaming solutions using Azure Event Hubs, Azure Stream Analytics, and Azure Databricks. Develop and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Data Factory and Databricks. Implement real-time data ingestion, transformation, and processing using Apache Spark Structured Streaming and PySpark. Integrate data from REST APIs, relational databases, NoSQL databases, event streams, and external systems. Work with Azure Cosmos DB and PostgreSQL, including direct integration with Azure Databricks. Design and optimize data storage solutions using Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Azure SQL, and Delta Lake. Implement data quality checks, monitoring, logging, error handling, and automated recovery mechanisms. Apply data modeling and lakehouse architecture principles to support analytical and operational workloads. Ensure data security, governance, integrity, and compliance. Optimize data pipelines for performance, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency. Develop and maintain backend services and APIs required for data integration and processing. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable data and software solutions. Required Skills & Experience 3+ years of professional experience in Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related technical field. Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure data services. Proven experience designing and implementing real-time streaming and batch data pipelines. Strong proficiency in Python, PySpark, and SQL. Practical experience with Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, and Azure Event Hubs. Experience integrating Azure Cosmos DB and PostgreSQL with Azure Databricks. Good understanding of Apache Kafka, Spark Structured Streaming, and event-driven architectures. Experience with Delta Lake, data lakehouse architectures, and data modeling. Understanding of event-time processing, windowing, checkpointing, and handling late-arriving data. Experience with data integration, transformation, and large-scale distributed processing. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git, and Azure DevOps. Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including OOP, design patterns, API development, and system design. Knowledge of software testing practices, including unit and integration testing. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. review_candidates.title: Software Engineer - Postgres Tooling
review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Engineer – Postgres Tooling based in India. As a Software Engineer specializing in PostgreSQL tooling, you will play a key role in building and maintaining open-source tools that help developers manage database schemas and migrations safely and efficiently. You will contribute to the evolution of a powerful schema comparison and migration engine, ensuring the accuracy, reliability, and security of generated SQL. Working at the intersection of database internals, software engineering, and compiler-style problem-solving, you will tackle complex technical challenges involving dependency management, permissions, and data integrity. You will collaborate with globally distributed engineering teams and open-source contributors to improve developer workflows and establish robust tooling standards. The role offers the opportunity to take technical ownership of a widely used project and help drive it toward a stable, standalone release. You will thrive in an asynchronous, open-source-first environment that values technical excellence, independent thinking, and engineering precision. Accountabilities Co-maintain and progressively take technical ownership of an open-source PostgreSQL schema comparison and migration engine, reviewing contributions and eventually growing into its lead maintainer. Review, evaluate, and merge code contributions, including AI-generated pull requests, while ensuring high standards of correctness, maintainability, and security. Investigate and resolve reported issues related to schema differences, dependency ordering, migration generation, and PostgreSQL compatibility. Expand automated testing and validation coverage across multiple PostgreSQL versions to ensure consistent and reliable behavior. Ensure generated database migrations are safe, privilege-aware, and designed to prevent unintended data loss or security regressions. Identify potentially destructive schema changes and implement mechanisms to detect them and generate safer alternatives wherever possible. Contribute to the development of a stable 1.0 release, including defining public APIs, establishing semantic versioning contracts, improving documentation, and expanding PostgreSQL extension support. Engage with the open-source community by managing issue reports, reviewing external contributions, providing technical guidance, and maintaining constructive discussions with contributors. Collaborate with internal engineering teams to ensure consistent migration generation and execution across products, platform services, database branching, and AI-powered workflows. Write technical design documents, define architectural direction, and establish engineering strategies for the continued evolution of the tooling. Participate in the engineering team's on-call rotation, helping investigate and resolve production-related issues while supporting reliable software delivery. Requirements At least 8 years of professional software engineering experience, including extensive hands-on experience with PostgreSQL. Deep understanding of PostgreSQL internals, particularly system catalogs such as pg_catalog and pg_depend, object ownership, permissions, grants, default privileges, Row-Level Security (RLS) policies, and extension membership. Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL DDL operations and database migration semantics, including locking behavior, transactional limitations, dependency management, and the identification of potentially destructive changes. A security-conscious engineering mindset, with particular attention to preventing unauthorized privilege changes, accidental access exposure, and unintended data loss. Strong proficiency in TypeScript and the ability to develop reliable, maintainable, and well-tested software. Experience designing advanced testing strategies for correctness, including differential testing, property-based testing, and test corpus validation across multiple PostgreSQL versions. Familiarity with compiler-style engineering challenges, including dependency graphs, topological sorting, cycle detection, and schema comparison algorithms. Ability to review and understand complex code changes within sophisticated codebases, including contributions generated with AI-assisted development tools. Proven experience owning and maintaining production software, including staged releases, error monitoring, incident investigation, and responding to real-world user feedback. Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives across multiple teams, from initial problem definition and architectural planning through production implementation. Excellent written communication skills and the ability to document technical decisions clearly. Ability to work independently, manage priorities effectively, and collaborate successfully within asynchronous, globally distributed engineering teams. Nice To Have Previous experience developing or maintaining database schema comparison and migration tools such as migra, pg-schema-diff, Atlas, pgroll, sqitch, Prisma Migrate, Flyway, or Liquibase. Familiarity with PostgreSQL backup and schema extraction internals, particularly pg_dump. Open-source project maintenance experience, including managing public APIs, semantic versioning, technical documentation, and community contributions. Knowledge of PostgreSQL extensions such as pg_cron, pgmq, pg_partman, vault, pg_net, pgvector, or PostGIS. Experience with Go programming language. Contributions to PostgreSQL itself or experience developing and maintaining PostgreSQL extensions. Previous experience working with PostgreSQL-based products or managed database platforms. Benefits Fully Remote Work: Work from anywhere in India within a globally distributed team, with no mandatory office attendance. Co-working Support: Access to a WeWork membership or co-working allowance to support a productive remote working environment. Equity Ownership (ESOP): Employee stock ownership opportunities, allowing team members to share in the company's long-term growth and success. Technology Allowance: Dedicated budget to purchase equipment and improve your workspace, including laptops, monitors, headphones, and other essential tools. Health Benefits: Comprehensive health insurance covering 100% of employee premiums and 80% of dependent premiums, subject to applicable plan terms and local eligibility. Annual Team Off-Sites: Opportunities to connect and collaborate with colleagues during company-wide gatherings in different cities around the world. Flexible Working Arrangements: Asynchronous work culture that encourages autonomy, flexibility, and ownership of your schedule. Professional Development: Annual learning and education allowance for courses, books, conferences, and other professional growth opportunities. International Collaboration: Opportunity to work alongside a globally distributed engineering team representing more than 60 countries and 20 languages. Open-Source Innovation: Work on impactful developer tools, contribute to the open-source ecosystem, and help shape the future of PostgreSQL development. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.
